source_exclusion: B REF M0 centroid, radius4*majorFWHM, actual native detector pointing
full_support_counts: own-arm full domain before intersection; spectral windows only require both arms when matched_other_arm is set
spectra: 4s rounded to even native N;50% overlap; median centering; Hann; one-sided PSD dt*absFFT²/sumh²; complete contiguous matched windows only; no zero fill
native_units: native x times accepted sample CAL multiplier; mJy²/nominalbeam²/Hz
cadence: native full band; all-stage matched uses identical physical length and common bins up to output Nyquist; absent higher output frequencies not measured suppression
population: all detectors included in support denominator; mapping-unavailable/source-overlap/incomplete-window detectors explicitly lack spectral estimate
line_recipe: 9.75–12.25Hz band, median continuum7–9.5/12.5–15Hz; nonnegative excess above continuum; maxbin/continuum>5 descriptive prominence only, not cleaning threshold
coherence: all pairs with >=3 genuine common windows; bin nearest11Hz; not attribution
event_recipe: adjacent absolute differences >8 raw matched-support MAD; retained edge within0.25s of unavailable sample; descriptive, not an independent event completeness claim
